mapper.insert: insert into cr_warn_rule (rule_name, data_source, condition_expr, risk_level, notify_targets, status, version, create_time) values (#{ruleName}, #{dataSource}, #{conditionExpr}, #{riskLevel}, #{notifyTargets}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createTime})
